purpose: Reduce repeated lookup transport for immutable, already copied canonical revisions while retaining exact original-byte restoration and separate native readbacks.

bounds.metadata_select: Exact publication_id/raw_sha256 primary-key OR branches; SQLite plan shows indexed SEARCH, no full table scan. Native query-plan cost not yet measured.
bounds.body_select: Exact same revisions, UTF8 byte lengths before bounded groups; compressed/original hashes and canonical binding verified.
bounds.missing_or_oversized: No negative cache; existing reader/writer path retained. All primary originals remain safe on any prefetch refusal.
bounds.four_private_native_readbacks: Always use original measured archive adapter, independently of prefetch cache.

current_phase_maintenance_fix.defect: The weekly/retention own lease acquisition accepted only LIQ_MAXIMUM_USEFUL_COVERAGE_IN_PROGRESS; current authorized ALL_ACTIVE105 task was rejected before provider/D1.
current_phase_maintenance_fix.fix: Accept exact current105 task only with the owner all-active plan reference and the existing weekly authorization in status, resume and phase; mint a20-minute current-owner-family CAS lease recognized by connected review. Never release foreign owners.

continuous_worker_replacement_fix.cause: The code guard includes private archive API, D1 budget guard and measured native D1, but the backup push trigger omitted those three paths. Their changes could stop the old worker without immediately requesting a replacement.
continuous_worker_replacement_fix.fix: Cover all guarded code paths in the existing replacement trigger; retain exact-source guard, existing schedule/concurrency and caps.
